Marta — quick technical note from payments: if you want us to retry we can do up to 3 authorization retries over the next 48 hours at decreasing intervals (immediate, +6h, +24h). Each retry will surface a 3DS prompt if the issuer requires it. If you'd like to proceed with retries, the best UX is for the cardholder to be available to approve.

If you send SEPA, please notify us with the transaction reference so we can apply it manually (SEPA receipts can take 1–2 business days).
